title: Tatarstan Toponyms: A Bilingual Dataset and Hybrid RAG System for Geospatial Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2605.05962v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper addresses end-to-end geospatial question answering over multilingual toponymic data. We introduce a bilingual (Russian-Tatar) dataset of 9,688 toponyms with linguistic, etymological, and coordinate information (93.1 percent georeferenced). Based on this, we construct about 39,000 question-context-answer triples with guaranteed answer localization. Our architecture combines a hybrid retriever (dense semantic indexing with multilingual-e5-large plus geospatial filtering/ranking using KD-trees and haversine distance) and an extractive reader fine-tuned on transformer models. On 500 test queries, hybrid search achieves Recall@1 = 0.988, Recall@5 = 1.000, MRR = 0.994, significantly outperforming BM25 and spatial-only methods. Among readers (RuBERT, XLM-RoBERTa-large, T5-RUS), XLM-RoBERTa-large gives best results: EM = 0.992, F1 = 0.994. translated_title: 鞑靼斯坦地名：双语数据集与混合RAG系统用于地理空间问答
translated_abstract: 本文解决了多语言地名数据上的端到端地理空间问答问题。我们引入了一个包含9,688个地名的双语（俄语-鞑靼语）数据集，其中包含语言、词源和坐标信息（93.1%已地理参考）。基于此，我们构建了约39,000个问答上下文三元组，并确保答案定位。我们的架构结合了混合检索器（使用multilingual-e5-large进行密集语义索引，以及基于KD树和haversine距离的地理空间过滤/排序）和微调过的抽取式阅读器。在500个测试查询上，混合搜索实现了Recall@1 = 0.988，Recall@5 = 1.000，MRR = 0.994，显著优于BM25和仅空间方法。在阅读器中（RuBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-large、T5-RUS），XLM-RoBERTa-large给出了最佳结果：EM = 0.992，F1 = 0.994。RuBERT模型在坐标问题上因分词伪影而失败，但简单的后处理可以解决。
tldr: 本文构建了首个俄语-鞑靼语双语地名数据集，并提出了一种结合混合检索与抽取式阅读器的地理空间问答系统，在测试中达到了高精度。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs the first Russian-Tatar bilingual toponym dataset and proposes a geospatial QA system combining hybrid retrieval with extractive reading, achieving high accuracy in tests.
